description: Direct rental quote from Galaxy Mind for S21 XP hashrate, priced per PH per day in BTC at today's published price and never below our floor. 270 TH minimum, quoted in whole-rig steps, up to 4 rigs (1.08 PH) or the number available now, for 1 to 30 whole days (default 1). Quotes are valid for 15 minutes and are indicative until the rental is finished with Galaxy Mind. This tool takes no payment and no orders; to rent, call create_rental (see closeTheSale).

days.description: Rental length in whole days, 1 to 7 days during the pilot, up to 30 later. Defaults to 1.

ph.description: Alternatively, the hashrate wanted in PH/s, up to 1.08. 270 TH minimum; rounded to whole rigs. Overrides rigs.

rigs.description: Number of whole S21 XP rigs (270 TH each, 270 TH minimum), 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.

name: get_rental_quote
